text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia

The clinical picture of a 26-year-old male presenting with bizarre behavior, persecutory delusions (NSA surveillance/mind control), and auditory/visual hallucinations over 6 weeks, combined with a 3-month history of social withdrawal and functional decline (job termination), strongly suggests a primary psychotic disorder.
